resources.string: This proxy\'s address is shown here while the connection is open and for ten minutes after it ends. It is not logged while \"Log where apps connect through your tool, WireGuard or a proxy\" is off.
Where the app asked the proxy to go is not shown, and not logged while \"Log where apps connect through your tool, WireGuard or a proxy\" is off.

Through the %1$s. Its address is no longer shown: while \"Log where apps connect through your tool, WireGuard or a proxy\" is off, Datapavan shows a proxy\'s address only while the connection is open and for ten minutes after it ends.

Through the %1$s in Android\'s settings, which other apps can use too. Its address is no longer shown: while \"Log where apps connect through your tool, WireGuard or a proxy\" is off, Datapavan shows a proxy\'s address only while the connection is open and for ten minutes after it ends.

Off unless you turn it on. It covers the apps you send through your circumvention tool or a WireGuard configuration, and the tool\'s own servers. Datapavan still counts their connections. It also covers apps that connect through a proxy, such as a Telegram proxy. While it is off, Now shows the proxy\'s address while the connection is open and for ten minutes after, and the log keeps that the app used a proxy, which kind, when, which known trackers it reached, and facts that name no address, such as whether a password was sent unencrypted. A list of where they went can be used against you if someone searches your phone.
Datapavan could not tell whether this connection went through a %1$s. Its address was not logged, because \"Log where apps connect through your tool, WireGuard or a proxy\" was off.
A proxy is set for the whole phone in Android\'s settings: %1$s. Most apps go through it.
Android\'s settings give a PAC file, which chooses a proxy for each connection.
This network\'s settings name a proxy: %1$s. Apps that were already running when Datapavan started use it, and so do the apps you left out. Others connect directly.
This network\'s settings give a PAC file. Apps that start inside Datapavan\'s VPN do not use it.
